subject: general
question: Who among the following is popularly known as ‘Waterman of India’?
solution:
The correct answer is:** '__Dr. Rajendra Singh__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajendra Singh is a **conservationist**. 
 
• He is also known as the **Waterman of India.**
 
• **He revived the traditional techniques of storing water in those parts of the villages of Rajasthan which were abandoned for decades by bringing water to them.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He won the **Ramon Magsaysay Award** for community leadership in **2001 **for his pioneering work in community-based efforts in** water harvesting and water management**.
 
• He also won **Stockholm Water Prize in 2015** for his innovative water restoration efforts, improving water security in rural India.
 
• He is a well-known water conservationist from Alwar district, Rajasthan in India.
